AccessControlBadConfirmation().details: The caller of a function is not the expected one. NOTE: Don't confuse with {AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount}.

AddressEmptyCode(address).details: There's no code at `target` (it is not a contract).

AddressInsufficientBalance(address).details: The ETH balance of the account is not enough to perform the operation.

ERC20InsufficientAllowance(address,uint2.details: Indicates a failure with the `spender`’s `allowance`. Used in transfers.

params.allowance: Amount of tokens a `spender` is allowed to operate with.
params.needed: Minimum amount required to perform a transfer.
params.spender: Address that may be allowed to operate on tokens without being their owner.

ERC20InsufficientBalance(address,uint256.details: Indicates an error related to the current `balance` of a `sender`. Used in transfers.

params.balance: Current balance for the interacting account.
params.needed: Minimum amount required to perform a transfer.
params.sender: Address whose tokens are being transferred.

ERC20InvalidApprover(address).details: Indicates a failure with the `approver` of a token to be approved. Used in approvals.

ERC20InvalidReceiver(address).details: Indicates a failure with the token `receiver`. Used in transfers.

params.receiver: Address to which tokens are being transferred.

ERC20InvalidSender(address).details: Indicates a failure with the token `sender`. Used in transfers.

params.sender: Address whose tokens are being transferred.

ERC20InvalidSpender(address).details: Indicates a failure with the `spender` to be approved. Used in approvals.

params.spender: Address that may be allowed to operate on tokens without being their owner.

ERC4626ExceededMaxDeposit(address,uint25.details: Attempted to deposit more assets than the max amount for `receiver`.

ERC4626ExceededMaxMint(address,uint256,u.details: Attempted to mint more shares than the max amount for `receiver`.

ERC4626ExceededMaxRedeem(address,uint256.details: Attempted to redeem more shares than the max amount for `receiver`.

ERC4626ExceededMaxWithdraw(address,uint2.details: Attempted to withdraw more assets than the max amount for `receiver`.

FailedInnerCall().details: A call to an address target failed. The target may have reverted.

SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC20 token failed.

params.sender: The address of the account that set the new state.
params.timestamp: The time at which the pause state was set.

params.sender: The address of the account that set the new state.
params.status: The new state of the deposit whitelist (`true` for enabled, `false` for disabled).
params.timestamp: The time at which the whitelist state was set.

params.account: The address of the account whose whitelist status was updated.
params.sender: The address of the account that set the new status.
params.status: The new whitelist status (`true` for whitelisted, `false` for not whitelisted).
params.timestamp: The time at which the whitelist status was set.

params.farmData: The `FarmData` struct containing details of the farm.
params.timestamp: The time at which the farm was set.

Initialized(uint64).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

params.sender: The address of the account that set the new limit.
params.timestamp: The time at which the limit was set.

RoleAdminChanged(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32.details: Emitted when `newAdminRole` is set as ``role``'s admin role, replacing `previousAdminRole` `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` is the starting admin for all roles, despite {RoleAdminChanged} not being emitted signaling this.

RoleGranted(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is granted `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call, an admin role bearer except when using {AccessControl-_setupRole}.

RoleRevoked(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is revoked `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call:   - if using `revokeRole`, it is the admin role bearer   - if using `renounceRole`, it is the role bearer (i.e. `account`)

params.symbioticCollateral: The address of the new symbiotic collateral.
params.timestamp: The time at which the symbiotic collateral was set.

params.sender: The address that initiated the push.
params.vaultAmount: The amount of assets pushed to the Symbiotic Vault.

params.symbioticVault: The address of the new symbiotic vault.
params.timestamp: The time at which the symbiotic vault was set.

Transfer(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when `value` tokens are moved from one account (`from`) to another (`to`). Note that `value` may be zero.

params.paused: The new state of the withdrawal pause (`true` for paused, `false` for unpaused).
params.sender: The address of the account that set the new state.
params.timestamp: The time at which the pause state was set.
The time at which the withdrawal queue was set.
params.withdrawalQueue: The address of the new withdrawal queue.

allowance(address,address).details: Returns the remaining number of tokens that `spender` will be allowed to spend on behalf of `owner` through {transferFrom}. This is zero by default. This value changes when {approve} or {transferFrom} are called.

params.owner: The address allowing the spender to spend tokens.
params.spender: The address allowed to spend tokens.

returns._0: The combined allowance for the owner and spender.

approve(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-approve}. NOTE: If `value` is the maximum `uint256`, the allowance is not updated on `transferFrom`. This is semantically equivalent to an infinite approval. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

balanceOf(address).details: Returns the value of tokens owned by `account`.

params.account: The address of the account to query.

returns._0: The combined balance of the account.

params.account: The address of the account initiating the withdrawal.
params.maxAmount: The maximum amount of assets to withdraw.
params.recipient: The address of the recipient receiving the assets.

returns._0: shares The actual number of shares claimed.

compatTotalSupply().details: The total supply decreases as users are migrated to the new vault.      When it reaches zero, complete migration to the `MellowSymbioticVault` can be finalized.

returns._0: compatTotalSupply The remaining total supply of the migrating vault.

decimals().details: Decimals are computed by adding the decimal offset on top of the underlying asset's decimals. This "original" value is cached during construction of the vault contract. If this read operation fails (e.g., the asset has not been created yet), a default of 18 is used to represent the underlying asset's decimals. See {IERC20Metadata-decimals}.

deposit(uint256,address).details: Mints shares Vault shares to receiver by depositing exactly amount of underlying tokens. - MUST emit the Deposit event. - MAY support an additional flow in which the underlying tokens are owned by the Vault contract before the   deposit execution, and are accounted for during deposit. - MUST revert if all of assets cannot be deposited (due to deposit limit being reached, slippage, the user not   approving enough underlying tokens to the Vault contract, etc). NOTE: most implementations will require pre-approval of the Vault with the Vault’s underlying asset token.

params.assets: The amount of underlying tokens to be deposited.
params.receiver: The address that will receive the vault shares.
params.referral: The address of the referral associated with the deposit.

returns.shares: The amount of vault shares minted to the `receiver`.

depositPause().details: When `true`, deposits into the vault are paused.

returns._0: paused The current state of the deposit pause.

depositWhitelist().details: When `true`, only whitelisted addresses are allowed to deposit into the vault.

returns._0: whitelistEnabled The current state of the deposit whitelist.

returns.accountAssets: The total amount of assets belonging to the account.
returns.accountInstantAssets: The amount of assets that can be withdrawn instantly.
returns.accountInstantShares: The amount of shares that can be withdrawn instantly.
returns.accountShares: The total amount of shares belonging to the account.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

getRoleMember(bytes32,uint256).details: Returns one of the accounts that have `role`. `index` must be a value between 0 and {getRoleMemberCount}, non-inclusive. Role bearers are not sorted in any particular way, and their ordering may change at any point. WARNING: When using {getRoleMember} and {getRoleMemberCount}, make sure you perform all queries on the same block. See the following https://forum.openzeppelin.com/t/iterating-over-elements-on-enumerableset-in-openzeppelin-contracts/2296[forum post] for more information.

getRoleMemberCount(bytes32).details: Returns the number of accounts that have `role`. Can be used together with {getRoleMember} to enumerate all bearers of a role.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

params.account: The address of the account to check.

returns._0: isWhitelisted `true` if the account is whitelisted, `false` otherwise.

limit().details: This limit can be applied to control the maximum allowed deposits.

maxDeposit(address).details: Returns the maximum amount of the underlying asset that can be deposited into the Vault for the receiver, through a deposit call. - MUST return a limited value if receiver is subject to some deposit limit. - MUST return 2 ** 256 - 1 if there is no limit on the maximum amount of assets that may be deposited. - MUST NOT revert.

maxMint(address).details: Returns the maximum amount of the Vault shares that can be minted for the receiver, through a mint call. - MUST return a limited value if receiver is subject to some mint limit. - MUST return 2 ** 256 - 1 if there is no limit on the maximum amount of shares that may be minted. - MUST NOT revert.

maxRedeem(address).details: Returns the maximum amount of Vault shares that can be redeemed from the owner balance in the Vault, through a redeem call. - MUST return a limited value if owner is subject to some withdrawal limit or timelock. - MUST return balanceOf(owner) if owner is not subject to any withdrawal limit or timelock. - MUST NOT revert.

maxWithdraw(address).details: Returns the maximum amount of the underlying asset that can be withdrawn from the owner balance in the Vault, through a withdraw call. - MUST return a limited value if owner is subject to some withdrawal limit or timelock. - MUST NOT revert.

params.user: The address of the user whose balance is being migrated.

params.from: The address of the user who is granting the approval.
params.to: The address of the spender who is being approved.

params.users: An array of addresses corresponding to the users whose balances are being migrated.

mint(uint256,address).details: Mints exactly shares Vault shares to receiver by depositing amount of underlying tokens. - MUST emit the Deposit event. - MAY support an additional flow in which the underlying tokens are owned by the Vault contract before the mint   execution, and are accounted for during mint. - MUST revert if all of shares cannot be minted (due to deposit limit being reached, slippage, the user not   approving enough underlying tokens to the Vault contract, etc). NOTE: most implementations will require pre-approval of the Vault with the Vault’s underlying asset token.

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

pauseDeposits().details: Once paused, no deposits can be made until unpaused.Can only be called by an address with the `PAUSE_DEPOSITS_ROLE`.

pauseWithdrawals().details: Once paused, no withdrawals can be processed until unpaused.Can only be called by an address with the `PAUSE_WITHDRAWALS_ROLE`.

returns.pendingAssets: The amount of pending assets that cannot be claimed yet.

pushIntoSymbiotic().details: This function first calculates the appropriate amounts to withdraw and deposit using `_calculatePushAmounts`.      It then performs the necessary withdrawals and deposits, adjusting allowances as needed.      Finally, it emits a `SymbioticPushed` event with the results.

returns.collateralDeposit: The amount of assets deposited into the collateral.
returns.collateralWithdrawal: The amount of collateral withdrawn to match the Symbiotic Vault deposit requirements.
returns.vaultDeposit: The amount of assets deposited into the Symbiotic Vault.

params.symbioticRewardsData: The data specific to the Symbiotic Vault's `claimRewards()` method.

redeem(uint256,address,address).details: Burns exactly shares from owner and sends assets of underlying tokens to receiver. - MUST emit the Withdraw event. - MAY support an additional flow in which the underlying tokens are owned by the Vault contract before the   redeem execution, and are accounted for during redeem. - MUST revert if all of shares cannot be redeemed (due to withdrawal limit being reached, slippage, the owner   not having enough shares, etc). NOTE: some implementations will require pre-requesting to the Vault before a withdrawal may be performed. Those methods should be performed separately.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

setDepositWhitelist(bool).details: When the whitelist is enabled, only addresses on the whitelist can deposit into the vault.Can only be called by an address with the `SET_DEPOSIT_WHITELIST_ROLE`.

params.status: The new whitelist status (`true` to enable, `false` to disable).

setDepositorWhitelistStatus(address,bool.details: Allows the contract to grant or revoke the ability of an account to make deposits based on the whitelist.Can only be called by an address with the `SET_DEPOSITOR_WHITELIST_STATUS_ROLE`.

params.account: The address of the account to be updated.
params.status: The new whitelist status for the account (`true` for whitelisted, `false` for not whitelisted).

setLimit(uint256).details: Can only be called by an address with the `SET_LIMIT_ROLE`.

params._limit: The new limit value to be set.

returns._0: vault The address of the Symbiotic DefaultCollateral.
data The `FarmData` struct for the specified farm.
farmCount The count of associated farms.

params.index: The index of the farm ID.

returns._0: farmId The farm ID at the specified index.
farmIds An array of farm IDs.
exists `true` if the farm ID exists, `false` otherwise.
vault The address of the Symbiotic Vault.

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token, usually a shorter version of the name.

totalAssets().details: Returns the total amount of the underlying asset that is “managed” by Vault. - SHOULD include any compounding that occurs from yield. - MUST be inclusive of any fees that are charged against assets in the Vault. - MUST NOT revert.

totalSupply().details: Returns the value of tokens in existence.

returns._0: The combined total supply of tokens.

transfer(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transfer}. Requirements: - `to` cannot be the zero address. - the caller must have a balance of at least `value`.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transferFrom}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. This is not required by the EIP. See the note at the beginning of {ERC20}. NOTE: Does not update the allowance if the current allowance is the maximum `uint256`. Requirements: - `from` and `to` cannot be the zero address. - `from` must have a balance of at least `value`. - the caller must have allowance for ``from``'s tokens of at least `value`.

unpauseDeposits().details: Once unpaused, deposits can be made again.Can only be called by an address with the `UNPAUSE_DEPOSITS_ROLE`.

unpauseWithdrawals().details: Once unpaused, withdrawals can be processed again.Can only be called by an address with the `UNPAUSE_WITHDRAWALS_ROLE`.

withdraw(uint256,address,address).details: Burns shares from owner and sends exactly assets of underlying tokens to receiver. - MUST emit the Withdraw event. - MAY support an additional flow in which the underlying tokens are owned by the Vault contract before the   withdraw execution, and are accounted for during withdraw. - MUST revert if all of assets cannot be withdrawn (due to withdrawal limit being reached, slippage, the owner   not having enough shares, etc). Note that some implementations will require pre-requesting to the Vault before a withdrawal may be performed. Those methods should be performed separately.

withdrawalPause().details: When `true`, withdrawals from the vault are paused.

returns._0: paused The current state of the withdrawal pause.
queue The address of the withdrawal queue.
